meta.title: FadeUp — Find the barber who gets your cut
meta.description: Search real barbershops and independent barbers near you. See who is open, book a time, or join the live queue from your phone.

hero.subtitle: Search the barbers actually on FadeUp. See who is open, book a time, or take a place in the queue from your phone.

discover.title: Real chairs. Real people.
discover.body: Every barber here runs their day on FadeUp, so what you see is what is genuinely open.
discover.emptyTitle: FadeUp is opening city by city.
discover.emptyBody: Search yours to see which barbers are already here.

book.title: Book a time. Or just walk in.

appointment.label: Appointment
appointment.title: Pick your slot
appointment.body: Choose your barber and a time that suits you. The chair is held.

queue.label: Live queue
queue.title: Join from your phone
queue.body: Walk-in shops run a live queue. Take a place, watch it move, and arrive when you are close.

passport.title: FadeUp remembers your cut.
passport.body: The number, the length, the beard line, the barber who got it right. It is yours, and it travels with you — even to a shop you have never sat in.

rebook.title: It gets better the second time.
rebook.body: No explaining it again. No starting over. Your barber already knows.

final.title: Find your barber.
final.subtitle: Search by city, shop, barber or service.

meta.title: FadeUp for barbershops — run the whole shop
meta.description: Appointments, walk-ins, the live queue, chairs and customers in one system built for barbershops. See the whole floor, remember every cut, and get found by new clients.

hero.subtitle: Appointments. Walk-ins. Chairs. Customers. One system, built for how a barbershop actually runs.

appointments.title: Your day, already organised.
appointments.body: Every booking, every barber, one screen. Open the shop and the day is already laid out.

walkins.title: But your shop is not only appointments.
walkins.body: Someone walks in without a booking. They pick a service, and a barber or the next one free.

queue.title: Walk in. Not wait around.
queue.body: They take a place from their phone and watch it move. Nobody stands by the door asking how long.

barber.title: The chair that frees up first.
barber.body: The queue hands the customer to a specific barber, or to whoever is next available.

chair.title: FadeUp works while you work.
chair.body: One screen at the chair: who is in it, what they asked for, what you did last time. Complete, and the next one is already there.

passport.title: Remember the cut.
passport.body: The guard, the length, the beard line. The customer owns it, and it means the second visit starts where the first ended.

history.title: Turn a cut into a customer.
history.body: Every visit builds a rhythm you can see — and a reason to reach out before they drift.

floor.title: See the whole floor.
floor.body: Chairs, barbers, the queue and what is coming next. Not just a calendar — the room.

owner.title: Today first. Everything else after.
owner.body: What is happening now sits at the top. Locations, team and services are there when you need them, not in your way.

team.title: Your barbers, your chairs, your rules.
team.body: Invite barbers and reception, set what each of them can do, and put them where they actually work.

marketplace.title: Meet the next ones.
marketplace.body: Your shop and every barber in it get a public profile. Same chairs, same services — now findable.

discovery.title: Found by city, service or name.
discovery.body: Customers search FadeUp for a barber near them. Published shops are what they find.

rebook.title: Back in the chair.
rebook.body: Same barber, same cut, one tap. The booking lands in today, and the day starts over.

loop.title: One system. From discovery to the next cut.
loop.body: Not a calendar with extras bolted on. Every step feeds the next one.

existing.title: Good. Your calendar is already digital.
existing.body: That was the easy part. What most booking tools do not touch is everything that happens after someone walks through the door.
existing.note: Bring your appointments across by hand or start fresh — there is no automatic import today, and we will not pretend otherwise.

pricing.title: The whole shop.
pricing.body: One price. Every barber, every chair, every feature on this page.
pricing.note: Reviewed within 24 hours. No card required.
